templates.name: Classic CampList (all-round car camping)
templates.tagline: The original CampList: a complete pre-trip script plus gear for a typical drive-in campground trip.

templates.name: Beach / Coastal Camping
templates.tagline: For campers pitching on sand or just above the shore at a seashore campground or wilderness beach.

templates.name: Bikepacking
templates.tagline: For riders carrying camp on the bike for multi-day routes over dirt, gravel, and pavement.

templates.name: Canoe / Kayak Camping
templates.tagline: For paddlers carrying camp in a boat on multi-day lake, river, or sheltered-coast trips.

templates.name: Desert Camping
templates.tagline: For campers heading into hot, dry, remote desert country where water and shade are scarce.

templates.name: Dispersed Camping (BLM / National Forest)
templates.tagline: For self-sufficient campers using free, undeveloped sites on public land with no facilities.

templates.name: Family Car Camping
templates.tagline: For parents taking kids to a developed campground with a car full of gear.

templates.name: Hammock Camping
templates.tagline: For campers sleeping off the ground between trees in three-season forest conditions.

templates.name: Overlanding / Remote Vehicle Camping
templates.tagline: For 4x4 travelers camping self-sufficiently for days at a time far from pavement and services.

templates.name: Three-Season Backpacking
templates.tagline: For hikers carrying everything on their back for 2-5 nights in spring, summer, or fall.

templates.name: Winter / Cold-Weather Camping
templates.tagline: For experienced campers sleeping on snow or in sub-freezing temperatures.

templates.name: A.T. Section Hike
templates.tagline: For hikers doing a 4-10 day section of the Appalachian Trail using shelters, designated campsites and trail-town resupplies.

templates.name: Boundary Waters Canoe Trip
templates.tagline: For paddlers taking a multi-day canoe-and-portage trip in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness during the May-September quota season.

templates.name: Grand Canyon Rim-to-River
templates.tagline: For backpackers hiking a corridor-trail rim-to-river route with nights at Bright Angel, Havasupai Gardens or Cottonwood campgrounds.
templates.season: Mar-May and Sept-Nov best; summer extreme heat; winter ice near the rims

templates.name: John Muir Trail Thru-Hike
templates.tagline: For hikers thru-hiking the 211-mile John Muir Trail between Yosemite Valley and Mount Whitney over two to four weeks.
templates.season: July-Sept (snow lingers on passes into July)

templates.name: Joshua Tree Camping
templates.tagline: For campers and backpackers visiting Joshua Tree National Park, where you bring every drop of water yourself.

templates.name: Smokies Backcountry Camping
templates.tagline: For backpackers spending one to four nights at designated backcountry campsites and shelters in Great Smoky Mountains National Park.
templates.season: Mar-Nov (peak Apr-May and Oct); wet year-round

templates.name: Yosemite Wilderness Backpacking
templates.tagline: For backpackers taking a multi-night wilderness trip in Yosemite National Park on a trailhead-quota permit.

templates.name: Zion Narrows
templates.tagline: For hikers wading the Virgin River Narrows bottom-up as a day hike or top-down (16 miles) on a day or one-night wilderness permit.
templates.season: Late May-Oct (spring runoff closures; closed above 150 cfs)

templates.name: Bonnaroo Camping
templates.tagline: For festival-goers car camping or tent camping for four days on the Bonnaroo Farm in Manchester, Tennessee.

templates.name: Burning Man (Black Rock City)
templates.tagline: For first-time or returning Burners camping a week in Black Rock City's alkali desert, where you bring everything in and take everything home.

templates.name: Electric Forest Camping
templates.tagline: For attendees camping four days at Electric Forest at the Double JJ Resort in Rothbury, Michigan, with GA or Good Life wristbands.

templates.name: Glastonbury Festival Camping
templates.tagline: For ticket holders tent camping five nights at Worthy Farm in Somerset, carrying everything in from the car parks or coach station.
